items.title: Al Grey interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 3, 1995
items.q: Jimmie Lunceford selected me, and Joe Wilder and Renauld Jones. And we all joined Jimmie Lunceford’s band.

ctx.x: Yes, see, so this has like been my history throughout life, this is how I was able to get in the band from reading. And so this is when Benny Carter accepted me, but then Benny Carter, after a year after that, he broke up his band to go into the studios out in Hollywood, to write for movies and he became very famous with “Peyton Place,” and see, which back in those times no one ever knew it because they didn’t give you credit for that at that time, see? It was a long time before Benny Carter was credited for…

Jimmie Lunceford came to see the Benny Carter band the last two nights that it was going to be together and Jimmie Lunceford selected me, and Joe Wilder and Renauld Jones. And we all joined Jimmie Lunceford’s band.
And then, tell us how you got to work with Basie.
